title: Miaomiao & Samsung connection
body:
When using the miaomiao reader on a Samsung S8, xDrip won't automatically update readings until a new pairing request is requested in the phones bluetooth settings. 

Have given xDrip as many privileges as I can but still won't update any readings following the initial backlog until a new pairing is requested.

comments.body:
Which xDrip version are you using? See `System Status` menu item for details.

The Galaxy S8 is reported to work well with miaomiao and pairing is not normally ever done with it.

I tried few versions in result with the same problem.

I'm also now experiencing similar issues .
Worked without any issues for almost 5 days, after that the connection is very unstable. 

Have tried to reboot phone, turn of and on Bluetooth, restarting collector, forgetting device, charging the phone and MiaoMiao etc. 
Selecting miaomiao in Bluetooth scan view , results in message that device is connecting but no connection is created.
Once when I tried to connect to the MiaoMiao using the phone native bluetooth view, it said that the connection was refused, but then xDrip+ got a connection and withheld i for around eight hours. Then back to the initial issue, but using native connection trick did not work any more.
Also sent logs from xDrip+

Additional Info to previous comment 
Installed Spike on an old iPhone 5S, and it found and connected to the MiaoMiao directly, no need to reset the MiaoMiao. Yet to see if it maintains connection though. Don't know if that adds any extra info, but I thought I would add it anyway :)

Maybe I am spamming...but here is some more info...
Uninstalled and reinstalled xDrip plus: 3534dc9-2018.05.21, with no luck.
Did a factory reset on the phone and reinstalled xDrip plus: 3534dc9-2018.05.21 and TADA!!!, suddenly everything was working again, did calibration and got readings. Set up Nightscout REST Url. wich also worked. Then I continued reinstalling some apps: Libre Link, Samsung Pay, BankID (a swedish identification app) and Swish (a swedish mobile money transfer app), then i realized that xDrip+ was not able to read values anymore, i got values for about 35 minutes... 
Tried to do all the tricks, and at the end I tried to stop and restart the sensor, then I saw that the 'waiting for initial data' dialog was a bit different.
When doing the initial setup, the dialog said  'Receiving Data from Tomato Collector' while when doing the sensor stop, start it said 'Receiving Data from LimiTTer Collector',
 could that mean anything?
